metadata.title: Tribal Belief system of Hatti in Himachal | हिमाचल के  हाटी समुदाय की कबीलाई धार्मिक मान्यताएं
metadata.description: Hatti community's proposal for inclusion in ST list has been approved by the central government after a wait of more than 50 years. Main Bhi Bharat team travelled to the trans Giri area to meet this community. In this episode we tried to understand religious practices and belief system of Haati community.
